headline: Rhode Island judge blocks policy that could limit immigrants’ access to social services
dek: The permanent injunction stops a federal directive that states said could restrict access to Head Start, community clinics, adult education and other programs funded through federal grants.
body: A federal judge in Rhode Island has permanently blocked a Trump administration directive that could have limited some immigrants’ access to federally supported social-service programs. The ruling, issued Monday, came after a coalition of 21 state attorneys general and the District of Columbia challenged the policy; Massachusetts was among the plaintiffs.

The directive sought to reinterpret a decades-old federal benefits law so that a broad group of programs could be treated as restricted for people classified as “nonqualified aliens.” That category includes undocumented immigrants as well as some people with work visas, Temporary Protected Status or protection under the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program, according to the Associated Press.

U.S. District Judge Mary McElroy had temporarily stopped the policy last year, so it never took effect. She later ruled that the administration’s change was unlawful and procedurally invalid. The affected programs include Head Start, Title X family-planning clinics, food banks, domestic-violence shelters, adult education and community health centers.

Massachusetts Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell’s office said nearly 96,000 patients use Title X clinics in the state and more than 44,000 adult learners use federally funded career and technical education programs each year. The office said enforcing the directive would have added costly immigration-verification requirements and created barriers for people seeking care and education.
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Rhode Island judge blocks immigrant social-services policy
seoDescription: A Rhode Island federal judge made permanent an injunction against a policy that could have limited immigrants’ access to Head Start and other services.
